name.ja: FULL MECHANICS 1/48 メイレスケンブ(初回限定クリア外装付き)
name.en: FULL MECHANICS 1/48 Meireskenbu (with first limited clear exterior)

ja: 2021年10月より放送開始の『境界戦機』から主人公機メイレスケンブがFULL MECHANICSにラインアップ！1/48スケールで構成することで、機体にフレーム構造を内包して立体化！
■リアスカートのアーム昇降アクションを再現。椎葉アモウの搭乗演出も可能。
■携行機関砲は部分的にシボ加工を施し表面モールドの高密度なディテールを表現。
■アモウのフィギュアも、立膝、着座状態の２種付属。
■「腕部超熱振式戦闘爪」「盾付短剣」が付属、組み替える事で装着可能。
■特殊な構造により広範囲な可動を実現した脚部は接地時に膝部装甲を引き出せるギミックを搭載。
■メタリック３Dシールにより、四肢のセンサーモールドの色を「グリーン」「レッド」から選択可能。
■メイレスケンブの装甲は組み立て途中のメカフレーム、武装が付属。パーツの差し替えで再現可能。
■初回生産の本商品は初回限定クリア外装が付属。内部フレームのモールドが透過し、メカニカルなデザインを感じられる仕上がりに組み立てる事が可能。
en: The main character Meireskenbu from "Kyoukai Senki", which will start broadcasting from 202110, will be added to the FULL MECHANICS lineup! By configuring it in 1/48 Scale, the frame structure is included in the aircraft and it becomes three-dimensional!
• Reproduces the arm raising and lowering action of the rear skirt. It is also possible to perform a boarding performance of Amou Shiiba.
• The portable machine gun is partially textured to express the high density detail of the surface mold.
• Two types of Amou figures are included: one in a standing position and one in a seated position.
• "Arm super heat wave fighting claw " and " dagger with shield" are included and can be attached by rearranging them.
• The legs have a special structure that allows for a wide range of movement, and are equipped with a gimmick that allows the knee armor to be pulled out when touching the ground.
• Metallic 3DSeal allows you to select the color of the limb sensor mold from "green " or " red".
• Meireskembu's armor comes with a mechanical frame and weapons in the assembly process. Can be reproduced by replacing parts.

• This first production product comes with a first limited clear exterior. The mold of the internal frame is transparent, allowing it to be assembled into a finish that gives a mechanical design feel.
